description.value:
You begin with a specialized toolkit called a custom rig. Your custom rig has 1 Bulk and counts as both a commercial repair toolkit plus any one of the following toolkits: a commercial hacking toolkit, a commercial infiltrator's toolkit, or a commercial maker's toolkit. You can use your custom rig with one hand if you're wearing it or two hands if you're holding it.

Whenever you purchase one of the listed toolkits, or a higher-grade version of one of the listed toolkits, you can spend 10 minutes integrating that toolkit into your custom rig without increasing its Bulk. Your custom rig and any integrated toolkits can't be sold or used by another creature.

If your custom rig is lost or destroyed, you can spend 1 hour building a new one. Your previous custom rig stops functioning, and your new custom rig doesn't have the properties of any previously integrated toolkits.
